newsitem.title: REPUBLIC OF IRELAND: Irish Life restructures investment division.
newsitem.headline: Irish Life restructures investment division.

text.p: Life assurance and investment management group Irish Life Plc said on Thursday that it was establishing its investment division as a separate company within the group.

"This is in line with group strategy to position each of its operating arms as distinct companies with individual business mandates and an independent position within the group," Irish Life said in a statement.
It named Monty Hilkowitz, a director of Irish Life and former managing director of Liberty Life of South Africa and of Westpac Life of Australia, as chairman of the new company.
Hilkowitz is also chairman of Irish Life International, Irish Life's company in Dublin's International Financial Services Centre, and will become an executive director of the group.
Irish Life managing director David Kingston said the appointment of Hilkowitz was significant given the growing internationalisation of the fund management business.

"Like many businesses, fund management is becoming an increasingly global affair. Irish Life wants to be part of that process and with his international experience and contacts, Monty Hilkowitz is ideally placed to help in this process," Kingston said.
Irish Life's investment division is one of the leading fund managers in Ireland with 6.8 billion Irish pounds of funds under management.
